set.note: Careful writers keep ensure separate from insure (to protect with insurance) and assure (to tell someone confidently to remove their doubts).

why: In American English 'insure' is also widely used to mean 'ensure'; note overstated the distinction
'occur' means happen, not a synonym of exist
'stand for' belongs to the symbol sense, not the defined 'act for' sense
'usually' is an adverb, not a verb synonym
'upgrade' is not used for promoting a person at work
'appealing' derives from the 'attractive' sense, not the defined legal sense; misleading as a related form
